record.paper: Towards Characterization of 5-List-Colorability of Toroidal Graphs

dossier_meta.paper: Towards Characterization of 5-List-Colorability of Toroidal Graphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: A toroidal graph is $5$-choosable if and only if it is $5$-colorable.
dossier_meta.context_text: This conjecture is stated as equivalent to Conjecture 2 and represents the central goal of the paper: a complete choosability analogue of Thomassen's characterization of 5-colorability on the torus. The computational results of the paper, enumerating minimal obstructions under a cyclic-triangle-system condition, provide supporting evidence.
